pages.text: The $(item)Item Dislocator$() pulls dropped items within 8 blocks into your inventory; the $(item)Awakened Item Dislocator$() reaches 32 blocks. $(l)Shift-right-click$() it to switch it on or off, or bind the Toggle Item Dislocator key in Controls.
It pauses while you sneak, leaves alone items that another player is standing closer to, and ignores items you threw until they could be picked up, so you can still hand things to friends.

pages.title: Blocking it
pages.text: The $(item)Dislocation Normalization Field Projector$() stops magnets taking items inside a box around it (size and offset per axis in its screen; shift-right-click steps a cube from 3 to 16). Stop XP holds XP orbs too. In All magnets mode it also stops most other mods' magnets. No power needed; it can follow redstone. Put one next to farms, mob drops or item displays.
